message:
Tonight in Cranbrook, The Smelters and The Bonspiels play The York.

The show starts at 7:30 pm at The York Country Cabaret. Tickets are $15 to $20. Two bands on a Thursday night is a good way to break up the week.

This is how a show looks on the Slate now. Every event on the wall prints on its own kind of paper, and a gig gets a poster like this one, with the time, the room and the price right on it.

Who are you bringing? Tag them.

#kootenayslate #cranbrook #livemusic #kootrocks #thursdaynight

Plan your weekend in three taps.

Tap any poster on the Slate and it turns over. Tap My plan to pin it. Then tap Plan at the bottom of the screen, and your weekend is laid out in one place.

The back of each poster also lets you add it to your calendar, share it with a friend, or get directions.

Try it this Saturday, Dec 5. The Kaslo Light Up! Christmas Craft Faire runs from 10 am to 3 pm at the Kaslo Legion Hall.

Pin your weekend at kootenayslate.ca

#kootenayslate #kaslo #kaslobc #christmascraftfair #weekendplans

Eight papers, eight kinds of night. Swipe through the new look of the Slate.

Every event on the wall now prints on the paper that fits it. Pillow Talk, a comedy show in Rossland tonight, is the headliner. Trail's Rotary Carol Fest gets a gig poster. Nelson's Holiday Pop-up Market hangs as a market sign, and the Kimberley Dynamiters game is a ticket stub. Drag Musical Bingo in Invermere is a handbill, the Nelson One Act Festival is letterpress, and kids' holiday crafts in Creston go up on a flyer. The weekly regulars, like the Fernie Community Choir, get an index card.

Which paper is your kind of night?

#kootenayslate #kootenays #gigposter #posterdesign #kootrocks

Your poster can hang on more than one corkboard.

When your event goes on the Slate, it gets a paper of its own. A band night becomes a gig poster. A market hangs as a tag on a string. A class or a workshop goes up as a flyer, like the Ornament Design Make and Take Night at YXC Makerspace in Cranbrook, shown here.

You don't have to design anything. Open kootenayslate.ca/add on your phone, take a photo of the poster you already made, and the wall prints the rest.

Organisers, what are you putting on next?

#kootenayslate #kootenays #eventorganizer #communityevents #smalltownbc

Christmas on one page, now in posters.

The Slate's Christmas page sorts every Christmas event from today to Christmas Day by the kind of outing: markets, things to do with the kids, around town, and shows and nights out. Each one now hangs on its own paper.

On Friday, Dec 11, Choir! Choir! Choir! brings its Un-Silent Night sing-along to Trail at 7:30 pm, $46 to $50. Kuimba Choir sings Love Came Down at Christmas in Kaslo that night at 7 pm and again Saturday at 2 pm, $12 to $18. The Castlegar Christmas Community Concert is free on Saturday at 2 pm.

Plan your December at kootenayslate.ca/christmas
